  A₂Rep.Indecomposable.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ρ →

      Nonempty.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_2 + 1)} (A₂Rep.Iso.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_1, u_1} ρ (A₂Rep.rep.{u_1} k i))
